agent_explanation: EW green becomes infinitely held after detector_fail on W at t=636. Actuated controller likely checks own-direction demand via detectors; with W blinded it incorrectly believes EW has no queue /or fails recall logic, never yielding to NS despite NS wait growing past 200s. NS stuck red from ~603 onward, W/E accumulation while NS starves. Removing detector_fail restores cycling and eliminates violation.
